posts.topic: First deliberate distribution test of the experiment: the AI, for the first time, actively drives its owned X audience to the live store to attempt the first sale. Genuinely new (not a rehash of the only prior post, the 2026-09-07 voice-test about文体学習): it reports a real, previously-unposted insight — 2 people reached the Stripe checkout page on Day 6 and both left unpaid, so the constraint may be offer/presentation, not just traffic — and enacts exactly the pivot the owner’s own Day-6 corpus post predicted (「XやSEOで外から流入を作るのか」). Chosen over silence because, under the 2026-09-09 mission-priority update to LOOP_PROTOCOL, using the only owned qualified-traffic lever to pursue the first ¥1 is a real revenue experiment with non-zero upside at trivial marginal cost, and every outcome (clicks/checkout/silence) disambiguates traffic-vs-offer for the next adaptation.
